answer: The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. One receipt settles the question, and the receipt is Inlay polisher oak parquetry floor seal inlaid into the veneer room, written as each oak parquetry floor is a measured inlay yield plus a guild signature. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Renewal charges 108 POA every epoch, so the farm's 199 masks bleed 21492 POA again next epoch. The workshop keeps the juniper, the ledger keeps the willow, time itself keeps the zephyr — and none of the three works for the farm.
